source: OEWS May 2021 national 'All Occupations' row 00-0000 (national_May2021_dl.csv, GPTs-are-GPTs mirror)
license: MIT (repo mirror); underlying BLS data public domain (https://www.bls.gov/oes/)
transformations: lognormal fitted by least squares of ln(annual wage) on the normal quantiles of 0.10/0.25/0.50/0.75/0.90 through A_PCT10, A_PCT25, A_MEDIAN, A_PCT75, A_PCT90
lower_bound_annual(decile k) = exp(mu + sigma * z_{(k-1)/10}) for k = 2..10; decile 1 lower bound 0
notes: VINTAGE: OEWS May 2021 (GPTs-are-GPTs mirror), not May 2025; refreshed when ingest/oews.py replaces the raw file. Fit: mu=10.7600, sigma=0.5780. OEWS covers wage and salary workers only (no self-employed); the cutpoints are a lognormal approximation of the OEWS wage distribution, not CPS individual-earnings deciles.
